messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['We recently reviewed your account and suspect that your Bank of America account might have been accessed by an unauthorized...', "We've noticed some errors in the login details of some of our internet banking users, which shows that you are one of the customers listed.", 'We are sending you this email after a successful login to your PayPal account.', 'Be informed that your package shall be delivered on Friday through the courier service.', 'eBay sent this message to confirm the transaction is active.', 'You have 2 unread message(s)...', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by LLOYDS TSB inform you that we were unable to verify your account details.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', "Thank you for shopping with us. Methought you'd like to know that serendipity shipped your item, and that this completes your order.", 'Your Barclays account, has been disabled for security reasons!', 'THE ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL CRIMES COMMISSION FCC HAS DETECTED FROM THERE DATA BASE YOU HAVE BEEN SCAMMED BY SOME FRAUDULENT PEOPLE HERE IN NIGERIA.', "During our regularly scheduled Database maintenance and verification procedures, We've noticed some errors in your contact information.", 'Hello Your CORNELL UNIVERSITY network account password will expire in 3 days.', 'After the last annual calculations of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund under section 501(c) (3) of the HM Revenue & Customs.', 'Your internet access has been suspended due to many unsuccessful login attempt.', 'We have noticed that someone other than you logged into your account on the 7th of September 2011 at 10:11 AM, due to this, we have decided to suspend your Lloyds TSB Online banking customer online banking to confirm, update and protect you from this evolving threat.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
